body:
> But then the filters values are not updated, which might leave the user with the "no results and I don't know why" UX...

I really think those API calls are necessary to refresh the refinements list; even if we don't use the underlying hits -> nothing superfluous here I would say.

I assume that in some very specific cases where you can ensure it will always return results, it could make sense but I don't have any in mind. For sure if it's to "save" API calls, we should not do it because the refinements refresh is as important as the hits refresh.
